subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should Matrix's 20-option protocol limit remain Matrix-owned, or become the default contract for every `normalizePollInput` plugin-SDK caller?
rationale: Current architecture carries differing limits at channel boundaries, while a universal fallback would redefine a public shared API and affect external plugins.

options.title: Cap Matrix explicitly
options.body: Pass `maxOptions: 20` from Matrix and retain the existing policy-neutral shared helper.

options.title: Define a universal ceiling
options.body: Keep the shared default only after explicit API-owner approval, SDK documentation, external-caller compatibility tests, and upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Cap Matrix explicitly
recommendation.body: Pass `maxOptions: 20` from Matrix and retain the existing policy-neutral shared helper.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared caller-configured normalizer and performed major poll architecture work, providing the strongest verified ownership trail.
